title: Otome:Or Not - My New Visual Novel in Development
author: SnooWalruses5620
selftext:
Hi guys, I've been working as a solo developer on a visual novel since the beginning of this year or so using an AI-Assisted workflow especially for art (sprites, bgs, cgs).

Rather than describe the whole wall of text here for the story and type of gameplay, feel free to check the main site where I'll also post updates! [https://coffeemist.itch.io/otome-or-not](https://coffeemist.itch.io/otome-or-not)

Just wanted to share the initial trailer and itch io site to get the word out there. I'm hoping to get the demo ready in a few days/likely a week from now (maybe earlier, am slow worker 😅). I'll make a post here when I do. 

Thanks for reading!
